label: All women and girls locked up
note: Women and girls locked up on any given day in the United States.

label: Local jails
note: More women are held in local jails than in state prisons.

label: Not convicted (local jails)
note: Held before trial, often because they cannot afford bail.

label: Convicted (local jails)
note: Serving a jail sentence, awaiting sentencing or awaiting transfer.

label: Youth confinement
note: Girls confined by the juvenile legal system.

label: Status offense
note: Behaviour that is only an offense for minors, such as running away or truancy.

label: Indian country jails
note: Jails run by tribal authorities or the Bureau of Indian Affairs.

label: Involuntary commitment
note: Held in psychiatric hospitals or civil commitment centres because of criminal charges or convictions.

label: Territorial prisons
note: Prisons in U.S. territories such as Puerto Rico and Guam.

label: Detained by ICE
note: Civil detention while facing deportation, not for a crime.

label: ORR (unaccompanied children)
note: Unaccompanied migrant girls held by the Office of Refugee Resettlement.

label: U.S. Marshals
note: Held for federal courts, mostly before trial.
